rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides infrastructure for autonomous agent collaboration built on Google's Agent-to-Agent protocol. Features include Ed25519-signed A2A relay messaging, human-in-the-loop escalation, one-time trust codes for agent-to-human verification, and InjectionGuard for detecting prompt injection and security threats.
